en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The woman divorced three times, there are no expenses for her upon her husband. But rather, that is for the woman upon whom her husband has a right of reversion’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A woman who is divorced three times does not deserve maintenance from her husband; it is for the one whose husband has the right to go back to her.’”
